author: /root/transport_scout
body:
Read-only scout result for #898; no edits or test/Lean runs.

Call chain: route coordinator `proof_contract_route_context._stage` (#L116-127) calls generic `proof_contract_obligation_supervision._execute_job/_run` (#L59-120), launching `ladon.proof_contract_route_context_worker`; its `_check_goal` (#L41-57) calls `correspondence_check._check_goal` (#L335 onward). That function creates `.ladon/correspondence/goal-*` with `TemporaryDirectory` (#L341), writes the typing prelude, performs a bounded Lean typing child, then rewrites `LadonCorrespondence.lean` with the actual proof hole before capture/completion/replay/trust (#L346-426). Normal Python exit/return runs TemporaryDirectory cleanup; SIGKILL bypasses it. Every stage returns through _execute_job, which converts timeout/memory/output stops to incomplete results, so lost worker cleanup does not gain proof authority.

Identity/consumer impact: keep the generated file visible and immutable while capture/replay runs; the source path is consumed by `capture_source_goal` and completion/replay from _check_goal. The recorded `TIMEOUT-RESIDUE.json` in localized-obligation-20261020 identifies the exact leaked path, and the resumed stale-context refusal/restoration evidence demonstrates it participates in the bound environment. Do not filter .ladon or goal-* from identity. Direct _check_goal consumers also include `proof_contract_context_worker._check_goal`, `proof_contract_probe_worker._check_goal`, and `proof_contract_bridge_worker`; a route-only fix leaves the same private checker vulnerable when those workers are killed. Ordinary direct API tests include `tests/test_correspondence_local_environment.py` and `tests/test_correspondence_provider_chain.py`.

Ownership design options: strongest narrow option is a parent-owned, per-attempt directory provisioned exclusively under the verified target `.ladon/correspondence`, with an unguessable attempt token and recorded directory identity; pass that exact location through internal worker environment/context, and make _check_goal use it while preserving standalone TemporaryDirectory behavior. Parent cleanup should operate only on that pre-owned path after it can establish no worker/descendant still uses it; remove only expected regular files/directories without following symlinks, and verify directory identity/containment before mutation. Alternative worker-written manifests are weaker because a hard kill can occur before the manifest is complete. Avoid glob-and-delete of goal-* or before/after tree diffs: they race concurrent workers and can erase preexisting/unowned files. Since other code can mutate the state parent, use lstat/no-follow checks and fail closed if parent, directory, or contents are replaced by a symlink or identity changes.

Important lifetime caveat: outer supervision uses `run_bounded_target_process` in `process_supervisor.py` (#L118 onward), whose timeout path signals its worker process group and reaps the worker. But nested Lean/helper invocations in that worker are separately started with `start_new_session=True`; a hard kill can bypass worker-side nested-group cleanup, and the outer supervisor has no recorded nested group id. Therefore “outer worker exited” may not prove all descendants have stopped using scratch. The implementation/regression should either demonstrate the target subprocess is gone before deleting content, or quarantine only the exact parent-owned attempt directory and defer exact deletion until lifetime is verifiable. Do not claim robust cleanup merely from TemporaryDirectory's finalizer or parent process reaping.

Smallest meaningful cross-cutting regression should target _execute_job with the real route-context worker entrypoint, observe that _check_goal reached the generated-file write, kill during that interval, assert incomplete timeout/no authority and exact owned scratch cleanup, then check a fresh source binding succeeds. Add controls for real source mutation and live goal tampering still refusing, and for a preexisting directory/file, symlink replacement, and simultaneous distinct attempt surviving. Relevant resource/worker stops coverage starts at `tests/test_proof_contract_route_context_stops.py`; checker subject/trust coverage is in `tests/test_correspondence_local_environment.py`.
